column1: # Does /v1/models report the adapters that are actually loaded?
# The HTTPRoute and the vLLM runtime are two independent registries of the
# same adapter set, and nothing reconciles them. This records both.
# kserve registers each adapter under TWO names (workload_lora.go:166-167):
# the bare name and the fully qualified one. The base is dual-registered too,
# via --served-model-name, so the cardinality is 2 x (1 + N).
# gateway http://172.18.255.2   namespace lora-budget   service svc-a
# --- direct on the pod, no gateway in the path (ground truth) ---
# --- /v1/models through the gateway, per addressing form ---
# in-route: the name appears in an X-Gateway-Model-Name Exact match
# Does the route follow? Does the runtime follow? Do they agree?

column5: runtime knows it; route does not
